notes.title: Update v.1.0.1.8
notes.notes:
Another update with fixes and changes.
Fixes:

 Fixed a bug that caused mission objectives to display incorrectly.
 Fixed a bug that prevented mass tunnel construction.
 Added a 1x1 curved conveyor belt to the list of buildings unlocked in the merging mission.

Changes:

 Added information about unlocking the challenge mode.
 Added information about the mode and biome in the save files.

notes.title: Update v. 1.0
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The final update is now ready for download!

New Features:

 New biomes (forest and desert).
 A new game mode after completing the campaign.
 Added a biome and game mode selection panel before starting a new map.
 New 1x1 conveyor turn and 1x1 tunnel turn.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44544592/1b2e3e2f80e2b5d340d3fe10e829a7cfb7566f34.png
Changes:

 Changed the layout of UI elements in the building section.
 Increased conveyor speed.
 Changed the appearance of the main menu (random biome).
 Simplified the building mechanics.
 Improved target checking mechanics.
 Reduced the area where the mouse detects the screen edge.

Fixes:

 Fixed the incorrect location for building the mixer.
 Fixed a bug that prevented the placement of certain conveyors on higher levels.
 Fixed a bug that allowed changing the direction of initial and final conveyors.
 Fixed the incorrect display of target colors.
 Fixed the descriptions of randomly generated objects.
 Fixed target descriptions after loading a save.
 Improved camera speed based on frame rate.
 Fixed the incorrect rotation of menu buildings.
 Fixed a bug that didn't load unlocked buildings properly after loading the game.

Note! Saves from previous versions of the game will not work.

notes.title: Update v.0.9.6.7
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Fixes:

 The press mechanic has been reworked and now uses its own objects, which will not cause the entire code to freeze.
 The description of the pipeline button has been improved.
 A bug that allowed the press to be built in the air has been fixed.
 The scaffolding of the turnaround building is now properly removed after the building is removed.
 The background of the selection panel has been enlarged to reduce the risk of the panel being turned off by dragging the cursor from the object collision to the panel collision.

Changes:

 Building selection has been changed and now you just need to hover over the building.
 Automatic switching to underground mode has been disabled because it conflicted with the changed selection mechanic.

New features:

 The press, pump, painter, and mixer buildings can now be stopped.
 You can now delete the selected building with the "Delete" key or change the conveyor belt direction with the "R" key.

notes.title: Hotfix Update v.0.9.6.6
notes.notes:
Additional fixes:

 Fixed camera controls by moving the cursor to the edge of the screen.
 Fixed a bug that caused incorrect data to be loaded with a large number of saves.

notes.title: Hotfix Update v.0.9.6.5
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

I have fixed a few more bugs that you reported to me:

 Pressing the "M" key while entering a save name no longer turns off the interface.
 Objects exiting the press now have correct rotations of individual elements.
 The press should no longer freeze when an object disappears unexpectedly.

notes.title: Hotfix Update v.0.9.6.4
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

After analyzing the reported bugs and numerous tests, I have made improvements to the game code to prevent errors during saving and loading the game.

The following bugs have been fixed:

 Game state not saving
 Game state loading freezing
 Finished objects getting stuck in the saw
 Red building ghost disappearing after building attempt
 Old green building ghost displaying when changing the direction of the conveyor belt
 Movement and rotation of an object transferred from the previous incarnation being removed after it is dropped by a miner


Thank you for your understanding and patience.
